description: This file defines a controller class for handling blog module functionalities in an OpenCart e-commerce application. It loads necessary models and language resources, fetches and processes blog article data, and renders a view with the retrieved blogs.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for managing the blog module, extending the core Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that loads language, models, fetches blog articles based on filtering settings, processes the articles, and renders the blog view.
